subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Homomorphic Encryption
description: A fast breakdown of Homomorphic Encryption for builders.

hook.text: What if you could do math on encrypted data without ever decrypting it? That's homomorphic encryption.

buildup.text: Normally, you decrypt data to process it. Homomorphic encryption lets you compute on ciphertext directly.

discovery.text: A hospital could analyze patient data in the cloud without the cloud provider ever seeing the actual records.

twist.text: Homomorphic encryption is still extremely slow — millions of times slower than regular computation.

climax.text: If perfected, it would let us use cloud computing without ever trusting the cloud with our data.

punchline.text: Compute on secrets. Never reveal them.

quiz.question: What makes homomorphic encryption revolutionary?
options: It allows computation on encrypted data without decrypting it first
It makes encryption ten times faster
It eliminates the need for encryption keys
